translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 2 JUAN
book.title: An tsabchilab u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic c’al an t’ocat abathuale Juan

content: Nana’ in Juan pel in eyal c’al an tamcunel ebchalab. Nan tu thuchanchal axe’ xi u tata’ uxum ebchalab tacuth c’al a Dios ani jaye a tsacamilchic. Nan tu c’anithalchic cum i junat exlal an chubaxtalab, ani ti c’anithalchic jaye patal jita’ ax in exlalits an chubaxtalab.
Nan tu c’anithalchic cum a cua’al t’aychithits ta ichich an chubaxtalab jant’ini’ nana’ne u cua’alits, ani ja’its ne’ets qui ets’ey co’oy al i ichich.

U lej le’ abal i Tata Dios junax c’al in Tsacamil i Ajatic Jesucristo ti co’onchichic a ichich c’al in alhua’ inictal. Ti yajnanchi ani ti jun ejetbethanchi a ichich c’al in c’anithomtal ani c’al an chubaxtalab.
In lej culbel cum talchic a tsacamilchic in aynanchal an chubaxtalab jant’ini’ tin le’ i Tata Dios ti eb.

Uxum ebchalab c’al a Cristo, nan tu lej uluth uchal abal pel in uchbixtal a Dios cu c’anitháxin tu ebchalab jun c’al xi jun. Yab pel i it uchbixtalab, cum jats ax it olchinenequits ma tam ta ts’i’quiyamal ca bela’ an Ajatic.
Max chubax u c’anithom huahua’ ne’ets qui putu c’al in uchbixtalchic a Dios. Ma tam ti ts’i’quiyamalits qui bela’ i ats’amalits abal pel i uchbil cu c’anitháxin jun c’al xi jun.
Hua’ats yan i inicchic xe’ets teje’ tsabal in ulal abal yab chubax ti hua’tsinenec ti inic a Jesucristo teje’ tsabal. Pel i c’ambix ani pel i tomolnax c’al a Cristo jitats quin ulu antsana’.
Ca lej t’aja’chic ti cuenta ca junini’ bela’ a Cristo ani ca alhua’ t’ojonchi abal quit quithat pithan an atabilab.
A Dios yab c’uajat c’al huahua’ max cu peley ani yabats qui aynanchi in exobchixtal a Cristo. C’uajat c’al huahua’ a Dios ani jaye in Tsacamil expith max qui junini’ aynanchi in exobchixtal a Cristo.
Max ca ulits ta q’uima’ jita’ quin le’na’ ti exobchi axi pil i cau yab jununul c’al in exobchixtal a Cristo, yab ca bats’u ta q’uima’ ani ma yab ca ucha’ ca tolminchat c’al a Dios.
Cum max antsana’ ta ca ucha’ ejtil max a tolmiyal quin olna’ i cau axi yab chubax.
Hua’atse yan i cau u le’ tu ucha’chic, tocat yab u le’ cu thucha’ al axe’ xi u. U le’ quin c’ale tu tsu’u abal cu t’ilmats ani cu lej jum putat culbe.
In tsacamilchic a at uxum ebchal c’al a Cristo ti abchalchic tihua’ i tsapnethomtalab. Pel i uxum ebchalab jaye tacuth c’al a Dios. Amén.
